Parameter.name: ADAPTER
Parameter.Description: Use the Adapter to invoke this service every set amount of time

Property.name: SuccessEmailSubject
Property.Description:
This is the subject to use on the success email.
It also uses replacement constants #FORDATE and #OUTSTANDINGCOUNT and if present it replaces with the Count in Global SAFETRACETOTELCOR and the date of report

Property.name: SucessEmailBody
Property.Description:
Email This is the body that will be included in the success email.
It also uses replacement constants #FORDATE and 3OUTSTANDINGCOUNT and if present it replaces with the Count in Global SAFETRACETOTELCOR and the date of report
